exempt.no-bare-react-native-ui: client/host-ui.tsx is the plugin-local composition that replaces the removed paseo-plugin-helper/client kit (xpufx-org/paseo#937, #924). It imports the plain React Native ScrollView/TextInput as the fallback for the two real scroll owners (the modal body and the code-block scroller) and for the modal-grade text field; the host sheet-gesture ScrollView must not be nested inside a host sheet (#219).
exempt.no-bespoke-react-native-interactions: Same plugin-local composition. The host SDK ships no button/toggle/tab pressable primitive, so Card/Badge/Button/Tabs/Select/InteractiveRow compose Pressable over react-native. Every other helper/UI rule is followed; this is the single interaction seam.
